title: Smart Data Models - ManufacturingMachineState
description: Data model representing the real-time operational state, production counters, and alarm telemetry of a manufacturing machine.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity Type. It has to be ManufacturingMachineState

alarmCount.description: Property. Total number of times the alarm system was triggered.

alarmLastMs.description: Property. Time duration of the most recent error/alarm occurrence.

alarmTotalMs.description: Property. Total accumulated time the machine was blocked in an error or alarm state.

counter.description: Property. Counts the quantity of viable product produced.

currentSpeed.description: Property. Current operating speed of the machine.

stateOffCount.description: Property. Counter of how many times the machine transitioned to the stopped state (OFF).

stateOffMs.description: Property. Total accumulated time the machine was stopped (OFF).

stateOnCount.description: Property. Counter of how many times the machine started its operation.

stateOnMs.description: Property. Total accumulated time of effective operation.

timestamp.description: Property. Timestamp representing the exact date and time when the record was emitted.

plcId.description: Relationship. Identifier of the associated PLC.

machineId.description: Relationship. Identifier of the associated Machine.
